name: [UPDATE] Escape Goblintown
desc:
Prepare to Escape Goblintown, or become a Goblin and tag the stray hoomans before they get away!

Hoomans— survive for eight minutes, or complete enough objectives to escape!

Goblins— tag all hoomans before they are able to escape!

Earn Gobloons to unlock new UGC, abilities and Goblin characters between matches!

Daily rewards reset at 00:00 UTC.

Controls (desktop):
E— (hold) activate objective
R— ability
Q— ult (Goblin only)
CTRL— prone

Tags: Escape, Horror, PVP, Asymmetric, Comedy, PIGGY, Dead By Daylight, Among Us, Flee The Facility, Monkey Tag, Murder Mystery
